name: ui-apexpages-standard-controller-actions-runtime

source.content: Account account = new Account(Name = 'Action Seed'); insert account; ApexPages.StandardController controller = new ApexPages.StandardController(account); account.Name = 'Action Updated'; PageReference quick = controller.quickSave(); System.assertNotEquals(null, quick); Account saved = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Id = :account.Id]; System.assertEquals('Action Updated', saved.Name); String expectedUrl = '/' + String.valueOf(account.Id); PageReference viewed = controller.view(); System.assertEquals(expectedUrl, viewed.getUrl()); PageReference edited = controller.edit(); System.assertEquals(expectedUrl, edited.getUrl()); PageReference cancelled = controller.cancel(); System.assertEquals(expectedUrl, cancelled.getUrl());
